exposure: All rows and published fit results already exposed. This is model-development diagnostics, not an independent empirical test.
candidate: Within the supplied static positive Newtonian-plus-attractive-scalar Green class, congruent angular/radial source patterns have a positive Laplace representation of each matched torque harmonic. Unknown common positive gain and common separation offset do not change its shape inequalities.
not_assumed_derived: static homogeneous field coefficients and linear response
applicable angle/torque transfer and uncertainty boxes
deterministic bounds from quoted standard errors
derivation: Prove complete monotonicity, log convexity and finite-difference inequalities directly from the positive Laplace measure, with a derivative-dependent mismatch bound for unequal source transforms.
Use positive Laplace sums and signed-source counterexamples as synthetic controls.
data_calculation: Use all95rows and all3channels, retaining signs and labels.

Compute the smallest common multiplier k on printed marginal torque errors allowing nonnegative monotone central-separation values, then allowing nonnegative decreasing convex values. Equal central separations share one latent value.
Separately relax monotonic ordering to only pairs whose separation intervals [s-sigma_s,s+sigma_s] are disjoint, treating these as hypothetical deterministic boxes, not confidence regions.
Do not fit a potential, scalar mass, absolute gain or separation offset. Do not label quoted marginal sigmas as a simultaneous confidence level.
Save every residual/candidate value and active constraint. A failed conditional shape diagnostic challenges the entire measurement/model contract, not gravity alone.
prohibited: No asserting a null physical result from feasible shape envelopes
No using published phase-aligned data as raw or independent
No treating unequal source patterns as automatically reflection positive
